def: A fungus (Ustilago foetida) which affects the ear of cereals,filling the grains with a fetid dust; -- also called pepperbrand.
The operation of separating water from spirits and acids, byevaporation or repeated distillation; -- called also concentration,especially when acids are the subject of it. [Obs.]
An order of ganoid fishes of which the bichir of Africa is aliving example. See Crossopterygii.
A tribe of Indians, mostly inhabiting Idaho.
Full of deeds or exploits; active; stirring. [R.] "A deedfullife." Tennyson.
Damaged by accidental exposure to light; light-fogged; -- saidof plates or films.
One of the serial segments of the spinal column.
Low; mean; boorish; vagabond. "Such pady persons." Digges(1585). "The paddy persons." Motley.
One of the hexane paraffins, found in petroleum, consisting oftwo propyl radicals. See Hexane.
